text:
I fixed six bugs in `catalog/`, but I haven't run `python3 -m unittest`. I have no command-execution tool in this session, so I checked each fix by reading it against the tests. Please run the suite to confirm it passes.

- **`search.py`**: it imported `normalize` from `catalog.nonexistent`. It now imports from `catalog.text`.
- **`members.py`**: `MAX_BORROWED` was 3 and is now 5, matching the lending policy comment and the tests.
- **`fees.py`**: the fee was `days_late + DAILY_FEE`. It is now `days_late * DAILY_FEE`.
- **`factory.py`**: `sample_books()` was missing `Emma`. I added `Book("Emma", "Austen", 1815, 1)`. I made up the author, year and copy count because the tests only check the title.
- **`inventory.py`**: `recent(n)` returned `n + 1` events because of an off-by-one in the slice. It now returns `n`, and an empty list when `n` is 0 or less.
- **`books.py`**: `parse_book` left the year as a string. It now converts it with `int(year)`.
